The [[WTA 1000 tournaments]], make up the elite tour for professional women's [[tennis]] organized by the [[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]] called the [[WTA Tour]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Tournament Calendar |url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments?level=WTA+1000&status=all |access-date=15 July 2025 |publisher=Women's Tennis Association}}</ref> The tier consists of ten mandatory events.

{{Toc limit|3}}
